import os import sys import time import pytest from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect if hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'): sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') def test_browser_navigation_and_title(): """Verify synchronous browser launch, navigation, and DOM title evaluation.""" start_time = time.time() with sync_playwright() as p: browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True) context = browser.new_context() page = context.new_page() response = page.goto("https://example.com") assert response.status == 200, f"Expected 200 OK, got {response.status}" title = page.title() assert "Example Domain" in title, f"Unexpected page title: {title}" first_p = page.locator("p").first expect(first_p).to_be_visible() os.makedirs("test-results", exist_ok=True) screenshot_path = os.path.join("test-results", "example-screenshot.png") page.screenshot(path=screenshot_path) assert os.path.exists(screenshot_path), "Screenshot file was not generated" browser.close() elapsed = time.time() - start_time print(f"\n[Playwright Python] [OK] Navigation & Title assertion passed in {elapsed:.2f}s") def test_form_interaction_and_dom_manipulation(): """Verify DOM interaction, inputs, click events, and evaluations.""" start_time = time.time() with sync_playwright() as p: browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True) page = browser.new_page() html_content = """ Playwright Test Form

Customer Portal

Ready
""" page.set_content(html_content) page.fill("#username", "john_doe") page.fill("#email", "john.doe@example.com") page.click("#submit-btn") status = page.locator("#status") expect(status).to_have_text("Submitted Successfully") browser.close() elapsed = time.time() - start_time print(f"[Playwright Python] [OK] Form interaction passed in {elapsed:.2f}s") if __name__ == "__main__": print("=" * 60) print("RUNNING REAL MICROSOFT PLAYWRIGHT PYTHON TEST SUITE") print("=" * 60) t0 = time.time() test_browser_navigation_and_title() test_form_interaction_and_dom_manipulation() total_time = time.time() - t0 print("=" * 60) print(f"ALL PLAYWRIGHT TESTS PASSED (Total execution time: {total_time:.2f}s)") print("=" * 60)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
import time
import subprocess
import os

if hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

def check_environment():
    print("[1/3] Checking Python & Playwright Installation...")
    try:
        import playwright
        import importlib.metadata
        v = importlib.metadata.version('playwright')
        print(f"      [OK] Playwright Python module found (v{v})")
        return True
    except ImportError:
        print("      [!] Playwright is not installed in Python.")
        print("      Installing now via 'python -m pip install playwright'...")
        t0 = time.time()
        res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "playwright"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if res.returncode != 0:
            print("Failed to install playwright:", res.stderr)
            return False
        print(f"      [OK] Playwright installed in {time.time() - t0:.2f}s")
        return True

def check_browser_binaries():
    print("[2/3] Checking Browser Binaries (Chromium)...")
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
        with sync_playwright() as p:
            b = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
            b.close()
        print(f"      [OK] Chromium browser verified ready in {time.time() - t0:.2f}s")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"      [!] Browser binaries need installation: {e}")
        print("      Running 'python -m playwright install chromium'...")
        t0 = time.time()
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "playwright", "install", "chromium"], check=True)
        print(f"      [OK] Chromium installed in {time.time() - t0:.2f}s")
        return True

def run_tests():
    print("[3/3] Executing Real Playwright Python Test Suite...")
    test_file = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "tests", "test_playwright_suite.py")
    t0 = time.time()
    res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, test_file], capture_output=True, text=True)
    duration = time.time() - t0
    
    print(res.stdout)
    if res.stderr:
        print("Standard error:\n", res.stderr)

    if res.returncode == 0:
        print(f"============================================================")
        print(f"BENCHMARK SUMMARY: Playwright Setup & Execution")
        print(f"============================================================")
        print(f"• Test Execution Latency: {duration:.2f} seconds")
        print(f"• Test Result: PASSED (100% Green)")
        print(f"• Screenshots Stored: test-results/example-screenshot.png")
        print(f"============================================================")
    else:
        print(f"Test suite failed with exit code {res.returncode}")
        sys.exit(res.returncode)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    t_start = time.time()
    if check_environment() and check_browser_binaries():
        run_tests()
    total = time.time() - t_start
    print(f"Total time elapsed: {total:.2f}s")
